title: sandwich
summary: An everyday lunch with a hidden link to a town in Kent.
question: Can you follow a sandwich from your lunchbox to an old settlement name?
completion: Four links solved! The food name honours the Earl of Sandwich; his title leads to Sandwich in Kent. Its older name Sandwic combines sand with wīc, a settlement word. Here it describes a settlement on sand. The food was not named after a witch, and this trail does not prove filled bread was invented in the town.
partner: A familiar word can carry a surprising history. Follow the evidence!
